name: chat-panel
description: Side pane with the you-should-know headline, /summary and the latest /recaps; native pane or cmux split

mode.title: Panel mode
mode.description: native (default): a pane inside Claude Code, in any terminal and the desktop app. cmux: a split to the right of the Claude pane in cmux (tmux split in tmux), drawn by ~/.claude/tools/chat-panel/panel.py.

autoOpen.title: Open on session start
autoOpen.description: Open the panel when a session starts. Off: open it with /panel.

testCommand.title: Test command
testCommand.description: The pytest command the Tests section reruns changed test files with, before the file names. Empty: off.
